anchors.reason: The abstract explicitly states, 'This dataset contains event-related potential (ERP) data from a picture naming task,' directly describing the data contained in this release.

metadata.methods_description: Participants wore 32 head and face electrodes (left mastoid reference) and were presented with 100 unique black-and-white line drawings (50 Semantic, 50 Identity categories), each preceded by a related or unrelated English distractor word (200 ms prime, 2000 ms picture duration). Participants named each picture aloud, and their vocal responses were digitized online. EEG was sampled continuously at 500 Hz with a bandpass of DC to 200 Hz, with event markers stored for ERP averaging; raw data were imported into EEGLAB and saved as .set files.
